validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:datamodel="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/datamodel" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" datamodel:srcexpr="'https://github.com/o/r/datamodels/json'" initial="a">
  <state id="a" datamodel:src="https://github.com/o/r/datamodels/json">
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `datamodel:srcexpr` is not an attribute of the `datamodel` vocabulary
notes: the `datamodel` vocabulary has exactly one attribute: `datamodel:src`, the URI of the data model's package

primary.message: a `datamodel` attribute on an element that names no data model

notes: only `<scxml>` names a data model (SCXML 1.0 §3.2.1), so only `<scxml>` may name its package; an invoked document declares its own `datamodel` and `datamodel:src`
diagnostics.help: move the attribute to the `<scxml>` whose data model it names, or remove it
